player_prompt.intro:
Uzuzuona {N} zithamanga zotachidwa moza m'moza.
Kwa kila step tunga [accept] kukheta thamanga *la pano*, kapena [continue] kukwana ikho uone inayake.
Ikiwa simukudziwa, mwadzudzula kukheta thamanga la mwamalilo.
Mwina (cholinga = 1) **koma** ikiwa thamanga ukudziwa ukuchita kwambiri ndi yabwino kwambiri ya zonse.
